title: External Sales Executive
experience: Previous experience in external sales, business development or a similar commercial role
description_text:
Our client, a well-established Maltese company specialising in the supply and installation of products for residential, commercial and hospitality projects, is looking for an experienced External Sales Executive / Business Development Representative to join their growing team.
 This is a field-based sales position, ideal for someone who enjoys meeting clients, developing business relationships and identifying new commercial opportunities.
 Main Responsibilities
 Proactively identify and approach potential clients to generate new business opportunities.
 Arrange appointments and conduct face-to-face visits with prospective customers.
 Develop and maintain strong relationships with hotels, restaurants, care homes, contractors, architects and other commercial clients.
 Promote the company's extensive range of products and solutions.
 Identify opportunities to expand the company's presence into new market sectors.
 Present suitable products and solutions based on clients' requirements.
 Prepare quotations, negotiate terms and follow up on sales opportunities.
 Manage the sales process from initial contact through to closing the deal.
 Maintain regular contact with existing customers and develop long-term business relationships.
 Monitor market trends and identify potential business opportunities.
 Products & Market Sectors
 The successful candidate will focus on developing business across several sectors, including:
 Hotel and restaurant furniture.
 Hotel supplies, including linen, towels and other hospitality products.
 Care homes and residential facilities.
 Internal doors and hotel doors.
 Glass and aluminium products.
 Pergolas and balcony railings.
 Other products and solutions within the company's portfolio.
 Requirements
 Previous experience in external sales, business development or a similar commercial role.
 Proven ability to generate new business and establish client relationships.
 Existing contacts within the hospitality, construction or commercial sectors will be considered a strong advantage.
 Excellent communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
 A proactive, target-driven and results-oriented approach.
 Ability to work independently, organise appointments and manage a sales pipeline.
 Confidence in conducting face-to-face client meetings and presentations.
 A valid driving licence and willingness to travel for client visits.
 Remuneration Package
 Guaranteed minimum income during the first three months to support the development of new business opportunities.
 Attractive commission structure thereafter, offering above-market earning potential based on sales performance.
 If you are an ambitious sales professional with a passion for business development and the ability to build lasting commercial relationships, we would love to hear from you!
